title: Entry store in the browser with an outbox
done_when: EntryStore and Outbox in frontend/src/data/ keep entries across a reload, seed once from the demo data, and fall back to memory with a visible note when storage fails; unit tests pass

title: Entry screen: enter any indicator by keyboard and clicks with its unit
done_when: An Entry tab lets the astronaut pick any indicator, type a value with its unit shown, a mission day and a time, see clear errors, and save with the keyboard alone; the new entry shows on Home at once; tests pass

title: Sync client that sends waiting entries when there is a link
done_when: flushOutbox sends pending entries through HttpSync when VITE_API_BASE_URL is set, keeps them waiting with NoopSync, never throws, and runs on the browser online event and on Send now; unit tests pass

title: Sync status: what is waiting and when it was last sent
done_when: The header shows how many entries wait to be sent, the last sent time as Day N HH:MM or Not sent yet, online or offline in words, and a Send now button that works by keyboard; tests pass

title: History screen against the person's own earlier values
done_when: A History tab shows, for a chosen indicator, the person's entries newest first and a sentence comparing the latest value with the median of that same person's earlier values; never a population; tests pass

title: History chart drawn in SVG with a text alternative
done_when: The History tab draws the values by mission day, the person's earlier median and each attention threshold with its level name in text, with a text summary for screen readers; no chart library; tests pass

title: Indicator details from the content file
done_when: Each Home row has a Details disclosure with Why it matters, How spaceflight affects it, the numbered measurement steps and How to prevent problems, with their sources; works by keyboard; tests pass

title: Offline after the first load with a service worker
done_when: After one online visit the deployed app reloads and works with the network off; the service worker is registered only in production builds; a Playwright test with the network off passes

title: Playwright demo path with an accessibility check on every screen
done_when: pnpm e2e runs the demo path Home to Entry to History with the keyboard only, fails on console errors, and axe finds no serious or critical issue on any screen; pnpm test and the Vercel build do not run it

title: Phone layout and public link check
done_when: Every screen works from 320 px wide with no sideways scrolling; the e2e test also runs in a phone viewport; Juli opens the public link on a real phone in a private window with no login

title: English and wording check over every screen text
done_when: A unit test reads every text in strings.ts and fails on non-English characters and on the words diagnosis, disease, risk percentage and AI; units and times follow STANDARDS.md

title: Demo recording from the app with subtitles ready to burn in
done_when: pnpm record saves a 1280 x 800 video of the demo path of 30 s or less and one screenshot per step; the SRT timings match the steps; the subtitle text comes from submission/video.md

title: Read the team's real config files
done_when: With the files of Phys, Bio 1 and Bio 2 in config/, the app shows no placeholder notice and the Content problems list is empty or sent to the file's owner

title: Connect the frontend to the backend API
done_when: With VITE_API_BASE_URL set on Vercel, entries are sent to and history is read from the backend contract that Eng 1 publishes; the public demo still works without it

title: FRONT_TOBACK.md: how the frontend connects to the backend
done_when: frontend/FRONT_TOBACK.md describes the data the frontend sends and reads, the endpoints, the environment variable, offline behaviour and how to test the link, for an agent or engineer working on the backend

title: Visual design: layout, colours, cards and light and dark themes
done_when: The app has a designed look: a header band, a centred layout, each indicator as a card, a type scale and spacing tokens, light and dark themes from the system setting; text contrast stays at least 4.5:1 and the e2e and unit tests still pass

title: Move the interface to MUI with the HeMoSo theme
done_when: Every screen is built with MUI components and a theme made from the style guide tokens, dark by default and light from the system setting; behaviour, texts and tests unchanged; contrast test passes; no CDN fonts; content problems only with ?team=1

title: Sign in with the face on the device (register and sign in)
done_when: A person registers their face once and later signs in by looking at the camera; matching runs in the browser with models served from the app; only a face descriptor is stored, in this browser; the person picker still works without a camera; tests pass

title: Face sign-in consent, delete and fallback
done_when: Before the camera opens a consent text says what is stored and that nothing is sent; Delete my face data removes it; camera denied or missing shows a clear message and the person picker; works by keyboard
